'''2000 Massachusetts State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament for Massachusetts, held on 29 April 2000. [[Eric Hunter]] won it, by his own DeckTech post<ref name="dt-6154">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6154 mass state winner H&R], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 30 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6154/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6154/ GitHub Pages].</ref>; his brother came 2nd.<ref name="ls120">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls120.htm Strangle], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001030052636/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls120.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000 (the Saturday before [[Mike Gemme]]'s 1 May 2000 post)<ref name="dt-6187">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6187 MA State DS HD deck], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 1 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6187/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6187/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
* '''Site:''' Massachusetts; Boxboro, Massachusetts<ref name="tr-d645" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]

== Dating ==

Dan Mailloux played this deck at "the Massachusetts State Championships" and went 2–1 (+35). The page names Third Anthology as its latest expansion, and Trandosite captured it on 30 October 2000. That points to the 2000 state championships rather than 1999.
